visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of five young adults (three males and two females) stands together in a well-lit studio environment. They are positioned in front of a white backdrop with visible professional lighting equipment, including a softbox and a ring light. One male has pink hair and wears a white sweater; another male wears a green graphic sweater, and the third wears a beige sweater and blue jeans. One female is in a blue dress with a brown vest, and the other is in a light blouse and black shorts. They interact with an on-screen camera interface overlay. (2) The scene shifts as the group attempts a challenge. One male accidentally triggers the camera timer, causing the group to disperse and laugh. A yellow focus box tracks their faces. They reset and begin a countdown. (3) As the countdown proceeds, the participants frantically run to hide behind various studio objects. One hides behind a clothing rack filled with jackets, another ducks under a table, and one climbs a ladder in the background. The camera pans to follow the movement. (4) The video captures the result of the timer with a still photo, which is then reviewed by the group. They point at their hiding spots on a digital screen, exhibiting amused facial expressions and pointing gestures. (5) A subsequent round shows more chaotic hiding attempts. One participant flips a wooden table to hide behind it, while another person falls during the scramble. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout. (6) The final phase shows the group gathered around to look at the photos on a phone or screen, zooming in on specific individuals' poorly hidden limbs or heads, followed by them laughing and reacting to their performance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-energy group banter in a studio. Multiple voices overlap with high pitch variability and excited tones. A quirky, upbeat electronic background track with a steady drum beat plays immediately. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers an outburst of collective laughter and shouting. The speech rate increases significantly. (3) A vocal countdown begins, accompanied by the sounds of rapid footsteps and rustling fabric as participants move. A loud percussive 'thud' occurs as a table is moved. (4) Chatter continues as the group reviews a photo. The tone is humorous and teasing, with occasional cartoonish 'boing' and 'whoosh' sound effects inserted for comedic emphasis. (5) Another countdown round features more intensive movement noises and high-arousal female screams. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. (6) The final segment features overlapping dialogue as individuals point out details in the photos, accompanied by repetitive comedic stinger SFX and fading BGM.
